Build a complete, usable local habit-tracker application through Surge. Plan and execute two milestones: (1) create habits, display them in a clear usable interface, and check or uncheck completion for the current day; (2) persist habits and daily completion across reloads and provide filtering. The result must run locally with documented commands, have meaningful automated tests, and support accessible keyboard interaction and understandable empty/error states. Use a suitable ordinary web application stack for this initially empty project. Keep real implementation, checks, and results visible in the Flow/task history. Do not stop after planning documents or a demonstration summary. The project will receive a separate follow-up after the working result, so retain its earlier history and artifacts. Use the codex-acp runtime and exact gpt-6.1-sol model for every agent stage in the generated Flow.
